title: 1RB0LF_1RC1RB_0RD0RC_1LE1LF_1LD---_0LB1LA: the exact phase map runs to phase 800 (1.6·10<sup>483</sup> steps) without a halt
text: Lean now proves the head's whole trip through the long block for every length (lean/Passes.lean), so a sweep depends only on the counter word. py/phasemap.py runs the counter as a cached odometer and the phase changes in full, exactly, to phase 800, checked against full sweeps through phase 13. The block grows as K' = 2K + 2, plus 8 at rare events; an event follows exactly the phases whose counter ends in 1^2 0^2, and the event at phase 490 was predicted from phase 218.
